Source record: docs/studies/analysis/pulsechain_synthetix_councils_20261001.md.
Synthetix councils and their copied PulseChain authority
SNX stakers elect the Spartan Council. That establishes how Synthetix selected its policy
representatives; it does not establish a currently operating PulseChain council or automatically replace
the signers controlling its copied contracts. The published May 2023 council names, copied L1
membership NFT and protocolDAO signing authority are three different records.
Election rules at the fork
The April 2023 election announcement specifies eight Spartan, four Treasury, five Ambassador and five
Grants seats. Seventeen is the subtotal for Spartan, Treasury and Ambassador; 22 includes Grants. The
epoch began on 30 April 2023. Nominations and voting occurred on Optimism, with L1 voting power
incorporated through a Merkle tree. All council election modules used quadratic weighting except
Treasury, which used linear weighting.
The pre-fork governance documentation describes voting power derived from debt ownership and a
staking snapshot before elections. Holding SNX or purchasing sUSD does not by itself establish eligible
voting power. SIP-207 documents the transition to on-chain Optimism elections and NFT membership.
The published May results identify:
Council Published members for the epoch
Spartan Adam, Burt, Cavalier, cyberduck, Danijel, dsacks, Jackson,
ml_sudo
Treasury Carrot Anderson, Elliptic-crv, Kain, SpartanGlory
Ambassador GUNBOAT s, Kevin, mastermojo, Matt, Westie
Grants ALEXANDER, CT, JVK, sunny, synthquest
These are historical Synthetix results, not verified current PulseChain officeholders. An Ethereum
state fork does not automatically copy the separate Optimism election state. No authenticated current
election/membership record from the private copied L2 was available to this study. Later Ethereum/
Optimism governance reorganizations also cannot be assumed to have propagated to PulseChain.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 436

Who can implement a protocol change?
The Spartan Council approves policy proposals. The protocolDAO implements approved changes through
its contract ownership and multisig. The pre-fork Spartan documentation also describes security bonds
deposited by protocolDAO signers and held under Spartan control. The exact copied bond-custody Safe
was not established here; that remains a specific unresolved control dependency.
The dotted arrow represents the governance process, not proof that an election result can force a
transaction from the multisig. The Safe voting tutorial lets a staked Safe cast a vote. Voting through a
Safe does not remove its owners, change its threshold or give one elected representative the power of
all its signers.

Contract / association Address Copied threshold Finding
Ambassador Council 0x46abfe1c972fca43766d6ad7
0e1c1df72f4bb4d1
2 of 5 Same comparison result
Grants Council candidate 0xeb9a82736cc030fc4a4cd4b5
3e9b2c67e153208d
3 of 5 Same comparison result
All five have empty enabled-module lists. Council Safe guard/fallback slots and proxy runtime also match
the inherited comparison. The 16 distinct signers of the four additional council/incentive Safes have
empty code at both pins; no nested contract signer was found among them. The protocolDAO signers
were checked in the wider control audit (Appendix 52). Equal public configuration cannot prove
unchanged private-key custody.
Associations are deliberately qualified: the Treasury and Grants candidates use Treasury and Grants
explorer labels. The incentive address is specified by SIP-294. The Ambassador address was published by
an Ambassador representative in the January 2023 delegate platform. These records locate relevant
custody contracts; they do not map every signer to a named May council member.
The Treasury candidate's masterCopy() getter reverted at both pins. This is not evidence that its
implementation is absent; slot-zero storage was separately read. Unsupported getters are retained as
errors, never decoded as zero-valued answers.
The old Spartan NFT on PulseChain
The March 2021 Synthetix announcement identifies the L1 Spartan Council NFT at 
0x023c66b7e13d30a3c46aa433fd2829763d5817c5. On PulseChain it still returns eight tokens and the administrative
owner 0xde910777c787903f78c89e7a0bf7f4c435cbb1fe, matching the inherited comparison.
The eight copied membership wallets are:
Token Membership wallet
1 0xcc2e5565abfc3b457e284d84e87a56583833afef
2 0x37ffbbee75b446b2854efff46736642be7a70a95
3 0xdf09b6bb09fdee5f8d4c17c6642f0a54d6a7654a
4 0x42f9134e9d3bf7eee1f8a5ac2a4328b059e7468c
5 0x656b7f17933ee35058d1beb8b6c65b580e799440
6 0x8be60fe9f7c8d940d8da9d5ddd0d8e0c15a4288b
7 0xa41228de09fd143727d6337585c6b02c698146bc
8 0x0bc3668d2aafa53ed5e5134ba13ec74ea195d000
Membership addresses and metadata match the inherited comparison. All metadata fields return the
same IPFS content identifier, so they do not identify eight individual people. This is the older L1
membership register, which predates the Optimism election system. Its eight wallets must not be
presented as the May 2023 winners or a verified current PulseChain council.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 438

Reproduction and research implication
Evidence is in artifacts/pulsechain-safe-governance-rollup-20261001/: council-safes-current.json, council-safes-
inherited.json, legacy-council-tokens.json, council-members-current.json and council-members-inherited.json.
Explicit manifests under Research/experiments/pulsechain_synthetix_council*20261001.json contain only getters,
code reads and storage reads. Historical sources and commit references are retained in the same
evidence batch. No transaction was signed, broadcast or simulated as an administrative action.
The peg thesis can include control of SNX voting power as a potential route to elected representation. It
cannot treat that as verified control of the copied protocolDAO, fresh destination messages or unlimited
synth issuance. Those require separate evidence of effective contract authority, source issuance,
accepted destination messaging and applicable collateral/cap conditions. Current PulseChain Spartan
officeholders and the copied Spartan bond-custody Safe remain unverified.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 439
